042/**
043 * Session for stream-based RDF serialization (binary formats like RDF/THRIFT, RDF/PROTO).
044 *
045 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
046 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe and is typically discarded after one use.
047 * </ul>
048 *
049 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
050 *    <li class='link'>{doc jmr.RdfDetails}
051 * </ul>
052 */
053@SuppressWarnings({
054   "rawtypes",
055   "unchecked",
056   "resource",
057   "java:S110", // Inheritance depth acceptable for serializer session hierarchy
058   "java:S115", // ARG_ prefix follows framework convention
059   "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for RDF stream serialization
060   "java:S6541"  // Brain method acceptable for RDF stream serialization dispatch logic
061})
062public class RdfStreamSerializerSession extends OutputStreamSerializerSession {

174   /**
175    * Creates a new builder for this session.
176    *
177    * @param ctx The serializer creating this session.
178    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
179    * @return A new builder.
180    */

185   private final Model model;
186   private final Property pRoot;
187   private final Property pValue;
188   private final Lang lang;
189   private final RdfStreamSerializer ctx;
190   private final Namespace[] namespaces;
191
192   protected RdfStreamSerializerSession(Builder builder) {
193      super(builder);
194      ctx = builder.ctx;
195
196      model = ModelFactory.createDefaultModel();
197      namespaces = ctx.getNamespaces();
198      addModelPrefix(ctx.getJuneauNs());
199      addModelPrefix(ctx.getJuneauBpNs());
200      if (namespaces != null) // HTT: RdfStreamSerializer.Builder only exposes language(); the delegated RdfSerializer's namespaces() is never set, so getNamespaces() always returns a non-null (empty) array here.
201         for (var ns : namespaces) // HTT: unreachable — namespaces is always empty for stream serializers; see guard above.
202            addModelPrefix(ns); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
203      pRoot = model.createProperty(ctx.getJuneauNs().getUri(), RDF_juneauNs_ROOT);
204      pValue = model.createProperty(ctx.getJuneauNs().getUri(), RDF_juneauNs_VALUE);
205
206      var langName = ctx.getLanguage();
207      lang = toLang(langName);
208      if (lang == null)
209         throw isex("Unknown RDF language: %s", langName);
210   }
211
212   @Override /* OutputStreamSerializerSession */
213   public boolean hasNativeBytes() {
214      // The RDF graph layer has no native byte-array literal type — byte[] is surfaced either as an
215      // xsd:base64Binary typed literal or as a plain string literal
216      // carrying the configured BinaryFormat's text wire form (at any other BinaryFormat, after the
217      // BinarySwap fires).
218      return false;
219   }
220
221   private static Lang toLang(String langName) {
222      var l = org.apache.jena.riot.RDFLanguages.nameToLang(langName);
223      if (l != null)
224         return l;
225      if ("RDF/PROTO".equals(langName)) // HTT - not registered in Jena's RDFLanguages
226         return Lang.RDFPROTO;
227      return null;
228   }
229
230   private void addModelPrefix(Namespace ns) {
231      model.setNsPrefix(ns.getName(), ns.getUri());
232   }

270   @SuppressWarnings({
271      "null" // aType/wType intentionally null before assignment in control flow
272   })
273   private RDFNode writeAnything(Object o, boolean isURI, ClassMeta<?> eType, String attrName, BeanPropertyMeta bpm, Resource parentResource) throws SerializeException {
274      var m = model;
275      ClassMeta<?> aType = push2(attrName, o, eType);
276      ClassMeta<?> wType = null;
277      ClassMeta<?> sType;
278
279      if (eType == null)
280         eType = object();
281      if (aType == null) {
282         o = null;
283         aType = object();
284      }
285      if (isOptional(aType)) {
286         o = getOptionalValue(o);
287         eType = getOptionalType(eType);
288         aType = getClassMetaForObject(o, object());
289      }
290      if (nn(o)) {
291         if (aType.isDelegate()) {
292            wType = aType;
293            aType = (ClassMeta)((Delegate)o).getBeanInfo();
294         }
295         sType = aType;
296         var swap = aType.getSwap(this);
297         if (nn(swap)) {
298            o = swap(swap, o);
299            sType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
300            if (sType.isObject())
301               sType = getClassMetaForObject(o);
302         }
303      } else {
304         sType = eType.getSerializedClassMeta(this);
305      }
306
307      var typeName = getBeanTypeName(this, eType, aType, bpm);
308      RDFNode n = null;
309
310      if (o == null || sType.isChar() && ((Character)o).charValue() == 0) {
311         if (nn(bpm)) {
312            if (isKeepNullProperties()) // HTT: bpm!=null only reaches this branch via writeBeanMap's line ~418 call site, which is itself only reached after canIgnoreValue(bpMeta,...) let a null/NUL value through — and canIgnoreValue only lets a null value through when isKeepNullProperties() is already true. So whenever this line executes, isKeepNullProperties() is structurally guaranteed true; the false side (leaving n unset) is dead in this call path.
313               n = m.createResource(RDF_NIL);
314         } else {
315            n = m.createResource(RDF_NIL);
316         }
317      } else if (sType.isUri() || isURI) {
318         // RDF URI gate must come before isBean/isMap/isCharSequence: @Uri-annotated values need Resource emission, not literal text.
319         var uri = getUri(o);
320         if (isAbsoluteUri(uri))
321            n = m.createResource(uri);
322         else
323            n = m.createLiteral(encodeTextInvalidChars(uri));
324      } else if (sType.isBean()) {
325         var bm = toBeanMap(o);
326         Object uri = null;
327         var rbm = ctx.getRdfBeanMeta(bm.getMeta());
328         if (rbm.hasBeanUri())
329            uri = rbm.getBeanUriProperty().get(bm, null);
330         var uri2 = getUri(uri);
331         n = m.createResource(uri2);
332         writeBeanMap(bm, (Resource)n, typeName);
333      } else if (sType.isMap() || (nn(wType) && wType.isMap())) { // HTT: 1 residual branch — the "wType.isMap()" right-hand sub-check is evaluated only when sType.isMap()==false AND nn(wType)==true, but the only concrete Delegate wrapper reaching this far, DelegateMap (internal.DelegateMap#getBeanInfo()), always returns a MAP-category ClassMeta, so sType.isMap() is already true before wType is even consulted; the sub-check's own "true" outcome is therefore never separately exercised (short-circuited away every time). Same root cause as line 350's identical pattern.
334         if (o instanceof BeanMap o2) { // HTT: suspected structurally dead. The only way to reach this else-if with wType!=null is via a Delegate (lines 291-294): for BeanMap specifically (which IS a Delegate, and IS a java.util.Map), aType gets reassigned to the WRAPPED bean's own BEAN-category ClassMeta, so sType ends up isBean()==true and dispatches through the EARLIER sType.isBean() branch (line 324) instead — this else-if is never reached for a real BeanMap. For the OTHER disjunct (sType.isMap() directly true, e.g. an ordinary Map/JsonMap), `o` is never itself a BeanMap. Confirmed empirically: RdfSerializer_Test#o10_stream_serialize_rawBeanMap_direct exercises the Delegate-unwrap path but still lands on isBean(), not here. Flagged, not deleted — see also RdfSerializerSession (non-stream) lines ~277-284, which have the identical pattern.
335            Object uri = null; // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
336            var rbm = ctx.getRdfBeanMeta(o2.getMeta()); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
337            if (rbm.hasBeanUri()) // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
338               uri = rbm.getBeanUriProperty().get(o2, null); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
339            var uri2 = getUri(uri); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
340            n = m.createResource(uri2); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
341            writeBeanMap(o2, (Resource)n, typeName); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
342         } else { // HTT: the residual "goto" jump instruction that would exit the if-block above is unreachable — see guard above; every actual invocation takes this else branch directly.
343            n = m.createResource();
344            writeMap((Map)o, (Resource)n, sType);
345         }
346      } else if (sType.isByteArray()) {
347         // byte[] gate must come before isCollectionOrArray: byte[] satisfies isArray() but RDF emits it as a typed base64 literal, not as a Seq of bytes.
348         var b64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString((byte[]) o);
349         n = m.createTypedLiteral(b64, XSDDatatype.XSDbase64Binary);
350      } else if (sType.isCollectionOrArray() || (nn(wType) && wType.isCollection())) { // HTT: the "nn(wType) && wType.isCollection()" fallback is suspected structurally dead for the same reason as the isMap() fallback above — the only concrete Delegate collection wrapper in the codebase, DelegateList (see internal.DelegateList#getBeanInfo()), always returns a COLLECTION-category ClassMeta from getBeanInfo(), so sType stays isCollectionOrArray()==true and the left disjunct is always what's satisfied; nn(wType)==true is therefore never actually evaluated at this specific check (short-circuited away). Confirmed empirically via k22_stream_delegate_list_thrift / l02_serialize_delegate_list, which exercise the Delegate-unwrap but never reach the wType-only side of this condition. Flagged, not deleted.
351         var c = sort(sType.isCollection() ? (Collection)o : toList(sType.inner(), o));
352         var f = ctx.getCollectionFormat();
353         var cRdf = ctx.getRdfClassMeta(sType);
354         var bpRdf = getRdfBeanPropertyMeta(bpm);
355         if (cRdf.getCollectionFormat() != RdfCollectionFormat.DEFAULT)
356            f = cRdf.getCollectionFormat();
357         if (bpRdf.getCollectionFormat() != RdfCollectionFormat.DEFAULT)
358            f = bpRdf.getCollectionFormat();
359         if (f == RdfCollectionFormat.MULTI_VALUED) {
360            writeToMultiProperties(c, eType, bpm, attrName, parentResource);
361         } else {
362            n = switch (f) {
363               case BAG -> writeToContainer(c, eType, m.createBag());
364               case LIST -> writeToList(c, eType);
365               default -> writeToContainer(c, eType, m.createSeq());
366            };
367         }
368      } else if (sType.isCharSequence() || sType.isChar()) {
369         n = m.createLiteral(encodeTextInvalidChars(o));
370      } else if (sType.isNumber() || sType.isBoolean()) {
371         if (!ctx.isAddLiteralTypes()) // HTT: RdfStreamSerializer.Builder only exposes language(); addLiteralTypes is always false for stream serializers.
372            n = m.createLiteral(o.toString());
373         else
374            n = m.createTypedLiteral(o); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
375      } else if (sType.isReader()) {
376         n = m.createLiteral(encodeTextInvalidChars(read((Reader)o, SerializerSession::handleThrown))); // HTT: the catch(IOException)->accept(e) path IS genuinely exercised (RdfSerializer_Test#o11_stream_serialize_reader_ioException_wrapped; a throwing Reader triggers this and yields a SerializeException wrapping the IOException — proven by a temporary System.err probe inside the lambda body during triage, which printed on every run) — but JaCoCo persistently reports the compiler-synthesized `lambda$writeAnything$0` method (the SerializerSession::handleThrown method-reference target) as 0% covered regardless, a known class of JaCoCo/javac-lambda-desugaring interaction where the synthetic method is invoked only via a functional-interface instance constructed in a different class (IoUtils.read) and its probe is never recorded. Waived as a tooling artifact, not a real gap.
377      } else if (sType.isInputStream()) {
378         n = m.createLiteral(encodeTextInvalidChars(read((InputStream)o, SerializerSession::handleThrown))); // HTT: same tooling artifact as the Reader branch above — RdfSerializer_Test#o12_stream_serialize_inputstream_ioException_wrapped exercises this (confirmed via the same temporary System.err probe technique), but JaCoCo reports the synthesized `lambda$writeAnything$1` method as 0% covered regardless. Waived as a tooling artifact, not a real gap.
379      } else {
380         n = m.createLiteral(encodeTextInvalidChars(toString(o)));
381      }
382
383      pop();
384      return n;
385   }

387   private void writeBeanMap(BeanMap<?> m, Resource r, String typeName) throws SerializeException {
388      var l = new ArrayList<BeanPropertyValue>();
389      if (nn(typeName)) {
390         var pm = m.getMeta().getTypeProperty();
391         l.add(new BeanPropertyValue(pm, pm.getName(), typeName, null));
392      }
393      var checkNull = (Predicate<Object>)(x -> isKeepNullProperties() || nn(x));
394      m.forEachValue(checkNull, (pMeta, key, value, thrown) -> l.add(new BeanPropertyValue(pMeta, key, value, thrown)));
395      Collections.reverse(l);
396      l.forEach(x -> {
397         var bpMeta = x.getMeta();
398         var cMeta = (ClassMeta<?>) bpMeta.getBeanInfo();
399         var bpRdf = getRdfBeanPropertyMeta(bpMeta);
400         var bpXml = getXmlBeanPropertyMeta(bpMeta);
401         if (bpRdf.isBeanUri())
402            return;
403         var key = x.getName();
404         var value = x.getValue();
405         var t = x.getThrown();
406         if (nn(t))
407            onBeanGetterException(bpMeta, t); // HTT: genuinely exercised — RdfSerializer_Test#o13_stream_beanGetterException_surfaces_onBeanGetterException triggers a real getter exception, confirmed reaching this exact call (with a non-null BeanRuntimeException `t`) via a temporary System.err probe during triage — onBeanGetterException then rethrows as SerializeException since isIgnoreInvocationExceptionsOnGetters() is false. Same JaCoCo tooling artifact as lines 376/378: a conditional basic block whose only content is a call that always throws (no local catch, no fall-through instruction) is never marked covered by this JaCoCo version even when demonstrably executed. Waived as a tooling artifact, not a real gap.
408         if (canIgnoreValue(bpMeta, key, value))
409            return;
410         var ns = bpRdf.getNamespace();
411         if (ns == null && ctx.isUseXmlNamespaces()) // HTT: RdfStreamSerializer.Builder only exposes language(); the delegated RdfSerializer's useXmlNamespaces defaults to true and is never overridden, so this is always true when reached.
412            ns = bpXml.getNamespace();
413         if (ns == null)
414            ns = ctx.getJuneauBpNs();
415         else if (ctx.isAutoDetectNamespaces()) // HTT: RdfStreamSerializer.Builder only exposes language(); the delegated RdfSerializer's autoDetectNamespaces defaults to true and is never overridden, so this is always true when reached.
416            addModelPrefix(ns);
417         var p = model.createProperty(ns.getUri(), encodeElementName(key));
418         var n = writeAnything(value, bpMeta.isUri(), cMeta, key, bpMeta, r);
419         if (nn(n))
420            r.addProperty(p, n);
421      });
422   }
423
424   private void writeMap(Map m, Resource r, ClassMeta<?> type) throws SerializeException {
425      m = sort(m);
426      var keyType = type.getKeyType();
427      var valueType = type.getValueType();
428      var l = CollectionUtils.toList(m.entrySet());
429      Collections.reverse(l);
430      l.forEach(x -> {
431         var entry = (Map.Entry<Object,Object>)x;
432         Object value = entry.getValue();
433         Object key = generalize(entry.getKey(), keyType);
434         var ns = ctx.getJuneauBpNs();
435         var p = model.createProperty(ns.getUri(), encodeElementName(toString(key)));
436         var n = writeAnything(value, false, valueType, toString(key), null, r);
437         if (nn(n)) // HTT: writeMap always passes bpm=null to writeAnything, and writeAnything's null-value branch unconditionally assigns n=RDF_NIL when bpm is null (regardless of keepNullProperties) — so n is never null here; the false side is only reachable when bpm != null (see writeBeanMap's equivalent check at line ~419). Flagged as suspected structurally-dead code in this call path, not fixed.
438            r.addProperty(p, n);
439      });
440   }
441
442   private Container writeToContainer(Collection c, ClassMeta<?> type, Container list) throws SerializeException {
443      var elementType = type.getElementType();
444      c.forEach(x -> list.add(writeAnything(x, false, elementType, null, null, null)));
445      return list;
446   }
447
448   private RDFList writeToList(Collection c, ClassMeta<?> type) throws SerializeException {
449      var elementType = type.getElementType();
450      List<RDFNode> l = listOfSize(c.size());
451      c.forEach(x -> l.add(writeAnything(x, false, elementType, null, null, null)));
452      return model.createList(l.iterator());
453   }
454
455   private void writeToMultiProperties(Collection c, ClassMeta<?> sType, BeanPropertyMeta bpm, String attrName, Resource parentResource) throws SerializeException {
456      var elementType = sType.getElementType();
457      var bpRdf = getRdfBeanPropertyMeta(bpm);
458      var bpXml = getXmlBeanPropertyMeta(bpm);
459      c.forEach(x -> {
460         var ns = bpRdf.getNamespace();
461         if (ns == null && ctx.isUseXmlNamespaces()) // HTT: RdfStreamSerializer.Builder only exposes language(); the delegated RdfSerializer's useXmlNamespaces defaults to true and is never overridden, so this is always true when reached.
462            ns = bpXml.getNamespace();
463         if (ns == null)
464            ns = ctx.getJuneauBpNs();
465         else if (ctx.isAutoDetectNamespaces()) // HTT: RdfStreamSerializer.Builder only exposes language(); the delegated RdfSerializer's autoDetectNamespaces defaults to true and is never overridden, so this is always true when reached.
466            addModelPrefix(ns);
467         var n2 = writeAnything(x, false, elementType, null, null, null);
468         var p = model.createProperty(ns.getUri(), encodeElementName(attrName));
469         parentResource.addProperty(p, n2);
470      });
471   }

473   @Override
474   protected void doWrite(SerializerPipe out, Object o) throws IOException, SerializeException {
475      var cm = getClassMetaForObject(o);
476      if (ctx.isLooseCollections() && nn(cm) && cm.isCollectionOrArray()) { // HTT: RdfStreamSerializer.Builder only exposes language(); looseCollections is always false for stream serializers.
477         Collection c = cm.isCollection() ? (Collection)o : toList(cm.inner(), o); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
478         forEachEntry(c, x -> writeAnything(x, false, object(), "root", null, null)); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
479      } else { // HTT: unreachable false-jump target of the guard above (looseCollections is always false for stream serializers, so every write() takes this else branch, but jacoco still marks the residual jump).
480         var n = writeAnything(o, false, getExpectedRootType(o), "root", null, null);
481         Resource r;
482         if (n.isLiteral()) {
483            r = model.createResource();
484            r.addProperty(pValue, n);
485         } else {
486            r = n.asResource();
487         }
488         if (ctx.isAddRootProp()) // HTT: RdfStreamSerializer.Builder only exposes language(); addRootProp is always false for stream serializers.
489            r.addProperty(pRoot, "true"); // HTT: unreachable — see guard above.
490      }
491      RDFDataMgr.write(out.getOutputStream(), model, lang);
492   }
